newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ASX substantial shareholding notices - April 24.
newsitem.headline: ASX substantial shareholding notices - April 24.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
Village Roadshow Broadcasting Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Austereo Limited on 22/04/1997, from 87,611,431 ordinary shares (53.49%) to 97,135,071 ordinary shares (55.75%).

As at 27/12/1996, Downer Group Limited has become entitled to 692,890 fully paid ordinary shares of $0.50 4,125,000 fully paid ordinary shares of $0.50 each 41,988,201 fully paid ordinary shares of $0.50 each ordinary shares in Century Drilling Limited at a consideration of $1.58 $1.59 $1.60 pursuant to the takeover offer. The highest cash sum paid for any of these shares was $1.60. Downer Group Limited has a total entitlement of 47,383,550 voting shares in Century Drilling Limited.
